summary: Immuron Ltd filed a 6-K with the SEC regarding a notification to the ASX under Appendix 3H. The company is cancelling 3,805,528 ordinary shares at AUD 0.032 per share as part of a buy-back of unmarketable parcels, announced on ASX on June 23, 2026. This is a de minimis capital return program targeting small shareholdings, not a broader issuer tender or special dividend. After cancellation, quoted shares will be 322,848,081. The filing is a routine report of a share cancellation, not a transformative capital event. No advisor or board recommendation is noted. Watch for any shareholder response if the buy-back expands.
